## Primary Cause
The primary cause of the revenue drop on day 2 (2025-03-11) compared to day 1 (2025-03-10) was the implementation of a 15% discount on all products. This discount significantly reduced the net revenue per order, especially for high-value items like the ELEC-4K-TV-001 and APPL-IPAD-AIR.

## Dollar Impact
The 15% discount resulted in a substantial revenue loss. Comparing the two days:

Day 1 (2025-03-10):
- Total net revenue: $8,499.90
- Average net revenue per order: $849.99

Day 2 (2025-03-11):
- Total net revenue: $3,832.49
- Average net revenue per order: $722.49

The total revenue drop was $4,667.41, representing a 55% decrease in net revenue compared to the previous day.

## Recommendation
To mitigate the revenue loss, I recommend implementing a tiered discount system. This would allow for higher discounts on lower-value items while maintaining full price on higher-value items. For example:

- Apply a 15% discount only on items priced below $100
- Maintain full price on items priced $100 or higher

This approach would help balance customer satisfaction with revenue retention, potentially reducing the revenue drop to around 30% while still offering attractive discounts to customers.
